classification.difficultyReason: Plot the supplied point and interpret each gradient as a horizontal run and signed vertical change to construct a second point and draw the line.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw the line through the point $(1,1)$ with a gradient of $m=\frac{2}{3}$.

answer.worked: Plot $(1,1)$. Move 3 units right and 2 units up to $(4,3)$. Draw a straight line through both points.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 13(a); teacher PDF page 68, printed page 443
spec.description: Unfilled coordinate axes with no grid or numeric ticks; rising line and red rise/run construction.
spec.mathematics: The line passes through (1,1) and (4,3), giving gradient 2/3; its equation is y=2x/3+1/3.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Draw the line through the point $(-3,4)$ with a gradient of $m=-\frac{3}{2}$.

answer.worked: Plot $(-3,4)$. Move 2 units right and 3 units down to $(-1,1)$. Draw a straight line through both points.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 13(b); teacher PDF page 68, printed page 443
spec.description: Unfilled coordinate axes with no grid or numeric ticks; falling line and red fall/run construction.
spec.mathematics: The line passes through (-3,4) and (-1,1), giving gradient -3/2; its equation is y=-3x/2-1/2.
